title: Best OP Auto Attack Hitbox Expander Auto Dodge ESP Noclip
features:
Ronix Hub - Dueling Grounds

Combat
- Auto attack with Light Combo, Heavy Combo, Mixed, Spam Light or Spam Heavy
- Spam attack mode, no delay between swings
- Attack speed (0.01-0.4 s) and attack range (5-50 studs)
- Go for the closest player or pick one from the list
- Target card with name, distance, HP, weapon and posture, updated live
- Faces your target while attacking
- Auto rush, puts you behind any target within 20 studs
- Attack Now button

Positioning
- Hold a spot on your target: behind, in front, above, left flank, right flank or orbiting
- Instant teleport or smooth tween into place
- Distance offset (1-12) and height offset (-3 to 15)

Critical Strike
- Auto critical, finishes any enemy whose posture is broken
- Critical rush, snaps you to them first
- Scan range for broken enemies (10-45 studs)
- Sound cue when a critical goes off
- Strike Now button

Target Lock
- Auto target lock through the game's own lock-on
- Clear Lock button

Hitbox
- Hitbox expander with size (3-25) and transparency sliders
- Expand the torso and other body parts as well

Defense
- Auto dodge roll when an enemy near you starts an attack
- Roll along your movement, backwards, or towards the enemy
- Trigger distance (6-25 studs) and cooldown (0.1-0.8 s)
- Spam dodge for back to back rolls
- Dodge Roll button
- Anti posture break, rolls and backs you off at 82% posture
- Escape distance (10-35 studs)

Movement
- Speed boost (16-80)
- Infinite stamina
- Noclip

Visuals
- Player ESP with name, HP, distance and weapon
- POSTURE BROKEN tag in gold on anyone you can finish
- Red chams that turn gold on a posture break
- Remove camera shake
- Custom FOV (70-120)

Lobby
- Create or leave a custom lobby
- Start the match when you are the host
- Leave your party

Misc
- Anti AFK, on by default
- FPS boost
- Rejoin, server hop and unload

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
